findings.desc: The REVIEW advisory injection ignores parallelGate.mode==='off'. resolveAuditConfig accepts 'off' as the reversible escape hatch (spec §4.7: mode off disables BOTH behaviors), but the injection only checks that parallelGateCfg exists, so story_review still appends decomposition_advisory issues when the gate is disabled. Fix: make decompositionAdvisoryIssues return [] when cfg.mode==='off' (keeps the gate mode-agnostic, puts the mode policy in the caller layer per §4.4); add a smoke assertion that mode:'off' yields no advisory issues even when the gate would return advisories.

MAJOR: storyRef() calls store.readScopeContract for self + each peer with NO try/catch. readScopeContract returns null only for a MISSING contract and RE-THROWS (SyntaxError) for a corrupt/unparseable scope-contract.json. The flatMap only handles null, so a single corrupt contract anywhere (peers=allStories) crashes the entire parallel_wave_create command — a NEW crash surface (the wave never read contracts pre-S4). Sibling story-review.ts wraps the identical reads in try/catch. Fix: read all contracts once via a safe try/catch helper into a Map in createParallelWave, pass to storyRef; treat a throw as a missing contract.

MAJOR: the smoke's adversarial 'does not throw' assertions exercise the pure helpers (computeScopeGlobOverlaps with omitted peers), NOT the real corrupt-peer crash site (storyRef's store.readScopeContract). They give false confidence that the corrupt-contract case is covered. Fix: extract an exported safeReadScopeContract(store, id) (try/catch -> null) used by createParallelWave, and assert in the smoke that a fake store whose readScopeContract THROWS yields null (no throw).

MINOR: scopeGlobOverlapDegradations is always passed explicitOverrideNote ' Explicit parallelSafe=yes is overridden by collection-level safety.', but this advisory does NOT change the safety tier, so nothing is overridden. Misleading human-facing text. Fix: pass '' (or an advisory-appropriate note).

MINOR: CHK-001 helpers tested in isolation; scopeGlobOverlapDegradations is fed a hand-written pairExample rather than computeScopeGlobOverlaps' actual output, so a separator change between the two helpers would not be caught. Fix: add one assertion composing scopeGlobOverlapDegradations(id, computeScopeGlobOverlaps(...)) and asserting the reason contains the composed pair string.
